description: Canonical routes for the currently deployed Feishu Ray services. This profile records configuration only; it is not a health or availability claim.

canonical_semantics.stateful_lifecycle: one create_session, ordered push_frame for every source frame, one finalize
canonical_semantics.camera_intrinsics: camera.intrinsics is model-grid [fx,fy,cx,cy]; camera.K_px retains source-grid K_px
canonical_semantics.request_rgb: uint8 HWC RGB on the target-area model grid

deployed_compatibility_semantics.rgb_channel_compensation: channel-symmetric grayscale makes the deployed extra R/B reversal invariant
deployed_compatibility_semantics.dynamic_pixel_compensation: zero every pixel where the submitted dynamic-ignore mask is positive
deployed_compatibility_semantics.motion_filter_mode: use upstream keyframe selection with per-frame keyframe_added validity
deployed_compatibility_semantics.dense_timeline: service records every admitted source frame in dense_source for trajectory filling
